title: About me
about: I'm a full-stack developer from Sinj, Croatia, with 4+ years of React, TypeScript and Node.js, mostly in small teams where one engineer covers a lot of ground: frontends, APIs, and smart contracts where the product needs them.

At Puffer I was one of two frontend engineers across five apps, from the restaking dApp to the puffer.fi rebrand, and I built the Puffer AI assistant: LLM tool calling over live protocol data, RAG and layered security.
Off the clock I build for my local football community: a club platform for NK OSK Otok and the Amo na Čanj festival site that ran 130 teams across five sports.

facts.label: Quick facts
facts.education: Master's in Electrical Engineering, University of Split

points: Shipped five apps in a two-person frontend team: the restaking dApp for deposits and withdrawals, the puffer.fi rebrand, the blog, the cross-chain interop app and an internal dashboard, on a shared design system tested with Vitest and Playwright.
Built Puffer's AI assistant, live in the Telegram bot: 31 tools on live data, RAG on pgvector, provider fallback and five layers of prompt-injection defence, red-teamed with promptfoo and garak.

Built six Node.js services behind the apps, a validator-registration verifier integrated into the protocol team's Rust guardian service, and the CRM the BD team tracks 160+ deals in, with a Telegram bot to read and add deals from chat.
Built the backend and on-chain infrastructure for Smart Ads, an in-game advertising platform: GraphQL APIs, microservices and event-driven AWS serverless pipelines for high-volume ad events.
Wrote the Solidity contracts for on-chain ad verification and wired them end to end into the React and Next.js frontend.
Part-time, alongside CS Computer Systems: built the backend of a crypto listings and token-voting platform (REST API, PostgreSQL model, voting logic, on-chain reward flows) on AWS.
Sole frontend developer on two production platforms used by hospitals and government: MediioChain for healthcare data exchange and e-Sljedivost, Croatia's food traceability portal.
Delivered React dashboards with real-time d3.js analytics, a React Native app, and chaincode in Go for Hyperledger Fabric.
Before the code: live and recorded match analysis and structured scouting reports for player profiling.
